reviews.review: A worthy successor to the Left 4 Dead series, Back 4 Blood is far more complex and detailed.  The card powerup system and weapon addition systems lend a level of detail to characters that simply did not exist in Left 4 Dead.  There are even a dozen different characters to choose from, instead of only 4.
its fun to play with friends
love the game being like Left 4 Dead's but can y'all update and show how many players are currently online so you're not sitting there waiting for nothing?

[h1]This Game is far from perfect, but the reviews here made me think it was UNDERRATED.[/h1]
[quote][b]Rating:[/b] 7.5/10[/quote]
I ain't a hardcore L4D fan and my review is purely from the POV of a person playing this game without any expectations beforehand. Just looking for a good shooting fun game. This one exceeds my desire in many areas.

Those graphics, those gameplay (wow the way the gun feels shooting zombies <3), and those sounds are really superb. One of the finest I have seen in my life. But this game does break the immersion for me. Those HUDs cover almost 25% of my screen and I couldn't find a way to disable it. All those great trailer and cinematics you see, yeah it's there but Mark those look so great because of no HUD. This game should definitely offer a toggle to switch HUD. I really hate this game for this alone, and now most of my SS of beautiful graphics are ruined.

After seeing some level recycling in the base game campaign, I was very disappointed like WTF I wasted my money on the Ultimate edition. I thought I will downvote the game because I started to get bored of its generic similar-level designs. But wow the expansions (Act 4,5,6) were so amazing, much much better than those base game ACT 1,2,3. Definitely try to get the expansions if possible if you like base gameplay already. It has awesome cinematics but don't expect any story than lore.

After watching this video as suggested by a gamer in the comments, I realised how generic shooter game this actually is.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EdRLNUGmFC8

They paid no attention to details like L4D did with characters and level designs but used its name for marketing and breaking people's expectations. You will definitely enjoy its graphics and shooting but it may come to an end when you realise how generic it is.
